mintAuthority.summary: CETES has native issuer-controlled issuance on Solana and Stellar. Solana Token-2022 minting is held by a 1-of-2 Etherfuse multisig, while the Stellar CETES asset is issued by its 3-of-5 classic Stellar issuer account with clawback enabled. Etherfuse's issuer backend supports the native subscription/redemption process; Base, Polygon, Monad, and Avalanche are LayerZero V2 OFT representations whose owner, rate-limit, peer, and proxy-upgrade powers are reviewed separately under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Etherfuse issuance backend
controls.evidence: Etherfuse mints native Solana Token-2022 and Stellar CETES on KYC'd subscription and burns on redemption at NAV against CETES bonds custodied via INDEVAL; supply creation is issuer-controlled with no permissionless native route. EVM destination minting is LayerZero OFT receive-path behavior and is excluded from this control.

review.evidence: Solana: re-pinned at finalized slots 474454153 and 474454559 on 2026-11-27 (2026-11-27T06:44:29Z), CETES mintAuthority remains A6nFyQb2ywFZe23yEC4JQtLLe9aLXtt7EUAD8MFftHYP (supply 10,073,822.904581 CETES, freezeAuthority None); the 1-of-2 Token-2022 multisig signer-list control pin remains unchanged since 2026-08-16 slot 439725250. Stellar: Horizon ledger 65695159 on 2026-11-27T06:44:27Z confirms the 3-of-5 issuer with auth_revocable and auth_clawback_enabled set; summing all disjoint Horizon custody buckets (authorized 34,978,290.3674642 + contracts_amount 18,725,577.0818831 + liquidity_pools_amount 13,813.2786225 + claimable_balances_amount 592.5445388 = 53,718,273.2725086) reconciles within 0.016% of Etherfuse's 53,726,454.9271707 Stellar total. The Base, Polygon, Monad, and Avalanche (0xa51e029a76c58e102360836193481d41363a8352, CETES_OFT) owner/ProxyAdmin paths are LayerZero V2 OFT representation controls reviewed solely under Bridge Risk. Economic posture remains issuer-controlled and unbounded with monthly BHR México reasonable-assurance examinations (latest 2026-11-25) and attestation-only supervision, without a named prudential supervisor.
